name: Villamandos (Spain)
description: Green field with a broad band across the centre of red, white and red stripes edged yellow, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Villamandos (a skull, crossed swords, a lion and an axe).
history: Municipal flag of Villamandos; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
